description: Read-only MCP server for a WikiCitadel wiki: eight read verbs — hybrid search with retrieval severance, page and raw-source reads under sensitivity gating, graph walks (neighbors) and shortest paths, claim lifecycle status, verbatim citations from the citation lockfile, and a corpus census. Writes are deliberately absent: they belong to the governed gateway.
name: io.github.muttookhan/wikicitadel-read
